Pilot's image is a quarter of the size and has no shell. Notifications are set up once in Pulse and shared by every app, or in Pilot when it runs alone; Discover has the same search, lists and filters as Prism.

**Access.** Pilot now has one Security setting, the same in every Beacon app: no login (the default: your local network gets in, connections from anywhere else are refused), login from outside your network, or login for everyone. If Pilot sees your devices under an unusual address, list the range in Settings or in `PILOT_AUTH_LOCAL_NETWORKS`. A login you had set carries over.

**Upgrading.** The custom-command notification is gone (there is no shell to run it); use the "Other app (URL)" channel instead. Your other notification channels carry over. The four old Discover list endpoints (`/discover/trending`, `/popular`, `/top-rated`, `/on-the-air`) are replaced by `/discover/browse`.
